title: TripActions x Lufthansa Launch Campaign
summary: Co-branded launch assets and approval workflows for the TripActions and Lufthansa partnership.
overview: I developed the launch assets for the TripActions and Lufthansa partnership and supported the approval process needed to align both brands.

projectBrief.context: TripActions and Lufthansa partnered on a co-branded travel experience.
projectBrief.challenge: The launch assets needed to bring both brands together clearly while moving through a shared approval process.
projectBrief.contribution: I developed the partnership launch assets and supported the cross-company approval workflow.
projectBrief.approach: I balanced each brand's visual requirements and refined the work with partner feedback until the launch materials were aligned.
projectBrief.outcome: The process produced an approved set of co-branded launch assets for the partnership.
